verdict.rationale: UKVI publishes some exact timing and fee figures: you can apply up to 3 months before your work start date, and founder-visa fees are £1,357 from outside the UK and £1,693 inside. Processing times are also published. However, nothing in the evidence describes filing deadlines whose miss triggers a penalty, nor any penalty or interest schedule with figures. missing for 10: published filing deadlines with consequences for missing them, an exact penalty schedule, interest charges on late filings, independent corroboration
